title: About
text:
InertialRange Labs AB is an AI engineering and data-platform consulting practice run by Farrukh Nauman, PhD, registered in Sweden (Aktiebolag) and based in Linköping.
I work as a Senior AI Engineer and principal consultant: I design and ship agentic systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — against real schemas and real data on enterprise platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Snowpark, SQL databases). When an engagement needs it, I also take interim / fractional leadership of data and AI teams. Across both, I combine implementation with tests that check the answers and behaviour your team depends on.

title: About
text:
Founder
Since August 2025 I’ve been consulting through InertialRange Labs AB. My current engagement (since November 2026) is as a Senior AI Engineer: I build AI agents on top of an analytics stack on Google Cloud (BigQuery), and I work on the evaluations and tracing used to improve them.
Before that I served as interim team lead for Data Science & Advanced Analytics (Sep 2025 – Jun 2026) at a global industrial manufacturer, leading a 4–7 person team across telemetry analytics, ML, and GenAI automation — owning the roadmap, stakeholder steering, and technical direction.
Before InertialRange, I held AI researcher and consultant roles at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden (Jul 2021 – Aug 2025), where I led a Vinnova-funded applied AI project on circular fashion (project lead, ~9M SEK) and contributed as AI lead to the EU CISUTAC initiative (~2M SEK). Earlier, I held research positions at the Niels Bohr Institute and the University of Rochester, where I also completed a PhD in Physics and Astronomy.
For my detailed profile, writing, and CV, see fnauman.com, and selected work for worked case studies.

title: About
text:
Why this company exists
InertialRange helps teams connect AI engineering to a concrete delivery decision: what to build, how to test it, and what evidence is needed before rollout. Each engagement combines hands-on implementation or evaluation with a clear scope and a usable handoff.
Running my own company also lets me choose the right engagements — the ones where I can take real ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

Start with a clear picture of reliability
The Agent Reliability Audit is a focused, fixed-price engagement, typically about two weeks once access and scope are agreed. It gives your team:

An evaluation suite built from representative questions and expected results.

title: Choose a starting point
text:
Agent Reliability Audit
For: data and AI teams with an analytics agent or LLM workflow in pilot or production who need evidence before expanding its use.
Typical duration: about two weeks after scope and access are agreed. Contract: fixed price, quoted for the agreed workflow and evaluation scope.
I review representative questions, expected results, and available traces. We agree what a correct answer means, then measure the current system and investigate the failures.
You receive:

An evaluation suite in your repository, with scoring rules and instructions for running it.
A baseline report with success rates, uncertainty, and the limits of the evaluation sample.
A failure breakdown and ranked fixes, reviewed with your team.

What I need from you: access to the agreed workflow and representative data or logs, plus a domain contact who can confirm expected answers. The proposal defines the sample and access requirements; results describe that scope.
Ask about an audit

title: Choose a starting point
text:
Agent Build Sprint
For: teams with one defined workflow to build, such as analytics questions over a warehouse or a coding-agent workflow for a migration.
Typical duration: four to six weeks. Contract: fixed price for an agreed scope.
We define the workflow, integrations, and acceptance criteria before committing to delivery, then finalise the evaluation cases in week one. I build the agent and its tests, review results with your team, and document the remaining limitations. Reserved evaluation cases help distinguish improvements from tuning to known examples.
You receive: a working implementation in your environment, source code and tests, evaluation results, and a production handoff plan. The proposal specifies deployment responsibilities and which integrations are included.
What I need from you: a workflow owner, access to the agreed platform, and representative questions or tasks with expected outcomes. Changes to scope are agreed before additional work begins.
Discuss a build sprint

title: Choose a starting point
text:
Reliability Retainer
For: teams with agents already in use, where models, prompts, tools, and data keep changing.
Contract: monthly fee for an agreed number of engineering days.
I re-run evaluations around agreed changes, investigate regressions, review agent changes, and add tests for recurring failures.
You receive: a monthly regression report, reviewed changes, and an updated evaluation suite. We agree the review cadence, capacity, and response expectations in the scope. If there is no baseline suite yet, we scope that setup first.
Discuss ongoing reliability work

title: Choose a starting point
text:
Embedded AI Engineering
For: teams that need a senior engineer or interim technical lead for a larger programme of work.
Contract: hourly or daily rate; engagements typically run for three months or more, directly or through your consultant broker.
I work inside your team on analytics agents, evaluations, data-platform integration, or migrations with coding agents. When needed, I also take responsibility for technical direction and team coordination.
You receive: hands-on delivery under your planning, with agreed responsibilities, milestones, and handover. Relevant experience includes BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, and interim leadership of a 4–7 person data science and analytics team.
Discuss embedded engineering

Describe the problem. Send a short brief or book an intro call. We establish fit and the decision or delivery you need.

Practical questions

What does it cost?
Audits and sprints are quoted at a fixed price once the workflow, data access, integrations, and acceptance criteria are understood. Retainers specify monthly capacity; embedded work uses an agreed rate. Send a brief to start that discussion.


Who will do the work?
Farrukh Nauman, the principal consultant behind InertialRange Labs AB. You work directly with the engineer responsible for delivery.


Can we use our existing platform and procurement process?
Engagements can be contracted directly or through a consultant broker. InertialRange Labs AB is a Swedish Aktiebolag, invoicing in SEK or EUR. Work is remote-first across the Nordics and EU, with onsite kickoffs and milestones when agreed. NDAs and your existing access controls can be included in the engagement setup.


Can we see relevant work first?
Yes. Selected work on fnauman.com includes technical examples and case studies covering analytics agents, migration validation, and pipeline optimisation.
